Bgr555Color.previous: ushort color words across SnesCgram (SetColor(int, ushort), Colors), every palette/paint catalog (Resolve/ColorAt/Color returning ushort, Dictionary<int, ushort> edits, ushort[] rows), palette fades and enemy palette effects, PpuMemorySnapshot.Cgram, and hand-written channel masks/shifts (x & 31, x >> 5 & 31, x >> 10, (ushort)(r | g << 5 | b << 10)) in ~180 files
Bgr555Color.type: readonly record struct Bgr555 (15-bit packed red/green/blue) with ColorChannel; channel access, strict and saturating construction, Map/Zip/With channel operations, ToRgba32 bit-replicating expansion, formatted ToString; no implicit numeric conversions
Bgr555Color.closedProof: CGRAM stores fifteen bits; channels are five bits in word order red 0-4, green 5-9, blue 10-14 (the SNES PPU color format)
Bgr555Color.transitions: none (value type); fades and paint derivations use Map/Zip over channels; native word arithmetic that carries across channels (Wrecked Ship ghost +$0421) is explicit at the word boundary
Bgr555Color.boundary: Bgr555.FromWord (strict, rejects bit 15) for stored words; Bgr555.FromCgramPortWord for the CGRAM data port, DMA uploads and glitched bus reads (bit 15 dropped); ToWord for ROM/WRAM/hash/fixture/GPU encodings; PaletteRgb5.ToBgr555/From for JSON; debugger states restore older word-shaped fields through DebuggerColorWordShapes
Bgr555Color.invalidValues: FromWord and the channel constructor throw ArgumentOutOfRangeException; asset loaders keep InvalidDataException for malformed content
Bgr555Color.consumers: SnesCgram, all Assets color/paint catalogs, palette-FX system and color sources, frontend fades (CartridgePaletteTransition, CinematicPaletteFader, ending/intro/title), enemy palette effects, renderers (software, Mode 7, D3D11 upload), asset extraction
Bgr555Color.tests: VerifyBgr555Domain (all 32768 words, port masking, bounds, expansion, operations, CGRAM, typed fade, debugger shapes) plus the existing palette suites and all five movie replays
